title: Guru Hargobind Blesses Phool With Rule and Prosperity

blocks.text: Kala turns the child's silent plea into an explicit petition. May the Guru bless him with means of livelihood, he asks, and the response that follows is not modest consolation but a sweeping future grant.

The Guru showered his plentiful blessings on Baba Phool, declaring that With a sovereign rule was Phool invested and that his destiny would include elephants, horses, guns and arms together with territorial rights between the rivers. The prophecy establishes political authority, military capacity, and social rise in a single blessing.
The page is therefore the charter moment of the Phulkian house. What looks like helplessness before the Guru is transfigured into a promise of statehood.
